name: c-repair
description: AI-assisted detection, repair, and validation for C coding standards. Currently supports CERT® C.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Choose how to run C Repair.
[Use a local model](command:crepair.setUpLocal)
[Connect OpenRouter](command:crepair.connectOpenRouter)
[Settings](command:crepair.openSettings)
After setup, try the basic workflow on a practice file:
[Open practice sample](command:crepair.openPracticeSample)
Need help? [Quick start & user guide](command:crepair.openUserGuide)

crepair.localSetup.markdownDescription:
[Local model settings](command:crepair.localSettings) — Current model, quantization, save location and reasoning.

[Set up or start local model](command:crepair.setUpLocal) — Choose a model for initial setup, or start with saved settings.

[C Repair Leaderboard](https://safe-c-ai.github.io/c-repair-leaderboard/cert-c/) — Compare CERT C model evaluation results.

crepair.apiKey.markdownDescription:
Stored in VS Code SecretStorage and never written to settings; this shortcut panel has no value of its own.

- [Connect OpenRouter (browser)](command:crepair.connectOpenRouter) — sign in and store the key automatically.
- [Set API Key manually](command:crepair.setApiKey) — paste an existing `sk-or-...` key.
- [Clear API Key](command:crepair.clearApiKey) — remove the stored key.

crepair.commands.markdownDescription:
Shortcuts to the main C Repair actions; this panel stores no value.

- [Quick start & user guide](command:crepair.openUserGuide) — learn Scan, review and Accept on a practice file.
- [Open practice sample](command:crepair.openPracticeSample) — open a fresh editable copy alongside the guide.
- [Set Up Bridge](command:crepair.setUpBridge) — prepare or update the Python bridge. Local setup includes initial preparation.
- [Export Repair Report](command:crepair.exportRepairReport) — save the current session as Markdown.
- [Scan Current File](command:crepair.scanCurrentFile) — scan the active `.c` file.
- [Scan & Fix Current File](command:crepair.scanAndFixCurrentFile) — scan, then generate repairs.
- [Edit Context](command:crepair.editContext) — review inferred external declarations.
- [Choose Model Mode](command:crepair.chooseModelMode) — choose the preset, free model or local setup. Use Model Mode for Custom.
- [Reset Extension State](command:crepair.resetExtensionState) — remove the API key, session and one-time state. Settings values are kept.

enumItemLabels: Local — run a downloaded model on the extension host; no API key
markdownEnumDescriptions: Preset — the model and provider preset of this C Repair release (currently DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on DeepInfra). Usage-based cost; the preset may change in future releases.
Free — uses `crepair.freeModel` at $0 with automatic routing. Quality, speed and availability are lower and the shared free pool can be rate-limited (429).
Custom — use the Model / Provider Policy / Provider Order / Reasoning Effort values below exactly as set. Unverified combinations are self-service.
Run all inference locally using your downloaded model. No OpenRouter key required.
crepair.modelMode.markdownDescription: The single source of truth for model routing. Preset (stored value `default`) uses this release's configured preset and incurs usage-based OpenRouter charges, typically a few cents per file; the preset may change between releases. Free uses `crepair.freeModel` at $0 with lower quality, speed and availability. Custom uses Model, Provider Policy, Provider Order and Allow Fallbacks exactly as configured; unverified combinations are self-service. Reasoning Effort applies in every mode. Restart the bridge to apply.

crepair.freeModel.markdownDescription: Used in Free mode and automatically when Preset mode's key has no credits. A one-time notice appears; Preset resumes after credits are added. OpenRouter routes it automatically, and the shared free pool may be slower, lower-quality or rate-limited (429). Restart the bridge to apply.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Nominal top level — the highest named setting. On most providers it maps to about the same budget as xhigh.
Very high reasoning effort. Highest repair quality; highest cost and latency.
Medium reasoning effort — a balance of quality against cost and latency.
Low reasoning effort — fast and cheap.
Nominal minimum — the smallest budget while still reasoning.
crepair.reasoningEffort.markdownDescription: Applies to repair, violation detection and validation gates in API modes (Preset, Free and Custom). Declaration completion uses reasoning off. The bridge converts each level to a thinking-token cap. Support for reasoning levels and token caps depends on the model and provider. Restart the bridge to apply. Local mode uses Reasoning in [Local model settings](command:crepair.localSettings); this API setting does not change local inference.

crepair.model.markdownDescription:
Custom mode's OpenRouter model ID. The initial value matches this release's preset, `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash` on DeepInfra. Model and provider choices can affect CERT C repair results. Restart the bridge to apply.

Guidance: [C Repair Leaderboard](https://safe-c-ai.github.io/c-repair-leaderboard/cert-c/) · [OpenRouter Rankings](https://openrouter.ai/rankings).

enumItemLabels: Private & cheapest — ZDR providers only, lowest price first (recommended)
crepair.providerPolicy.markdownDescription: Used in Custom mode only when Provider Order is empty. Private & cheapest restricts routing to Zero Data Retention providers and sorts by price; if the model has no ZDR endpoint the request may fail — switch to Balanced in that case. Balanced uses OpenRouter's default routing. Restart the bridge to apply.

crepair.providerOrder.markdownDescription: Custom-mode provider priority, e.g. `["DeepInfra"]`. An empty array enables automatic routing through Provider Policy. `["DeepInfra"]` is verified; other orders are self-service. [View providers for the Custom model](command:crepair.openModelProviders). Restart the bridge to apply.

crepair.allowFallbacks.markdownDescription: In Custom mode, permit routing outside Provider Order. The verified default is `false`; enabling this makes the serving provider non-deterministic. Restart the bridge to apply.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Open the Context Review only when the scan infers missing external declarations (items > 0). Self-contained files skip straight to scanning.
Legacy: currently equivalent to when-needed. An empty Review carries no information, so files with no inferred items still skip it.
Never open the Review. Inferred context is left unconfirmed, so dependent findings/candidates are shown as assumption-dependent and the compile check is skipped.
crepair.contextReview.markdownDescription: Controls the editable review shown when missing external declarations are inferred. `never` skips it, making dependent results assumption-dependent and skipping compile validation. Legacy `always` is currently equivalent to `when-needed`. Takes effect on the next scan.

crepair.compileIncludePaths.markdownDescription: Extra header directories passed to compile validation as `-I`, reducing checks skipped because declarations cannot be resolved. Takes effect on the next scan.

crepair.autoIncludeFileDir.markdownDescription: Adds the scanned file's directory to compile-validation `-I` paths so adjacent headers are found. Disable when managing all paths through `crepair.compileIncludePaths`. Takes effect on the next scan.

crepair.autoRepairLimit.markdownDescription: Scan & Fix generates automatically at or below this count. Above it, choose all repairs, the first N, or cancel, preventing many unprompted LLM calls. Plain Scan never generates repairs.

crepair.report.includeRejectedProposals.markdownDescription: Add rejected proposed diffs to exported reports as reference material marked NOT applied. Enable when hand-fixing rejected candidates.

crepair.externalRouteNotice.markdownDescription: Before the first scan, confirm that source code will be sent through OpenRouter to an external LLM provider. Disable to skip this one-time prompt.

crepair.showCosts.markdownDescription: Query the key's cumulative OpenRouter usage for approximate spend in the status tooltip and Scan & Fix completion. This includes other usage of the same key. When disabled, the usage endpoint is not contacted. The key remains in secure storage, is sent only as an Authorization header and is never logged.

crepair.menu.showScan.markdownDescription: Show Scan Current File in the editor context menu. The command remains available in the Command Palette.

crepair.menu.showScanAndFix.markdownDescription: Show Scan & Fix Current File in the editor context menu. The command remains available in the Command Palette.

crepair.bridge.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Absolute Python interpreter path for the repair-api bridge. Empty uses `${workspaceFolder}/services/repair-api/.venv/bin/python` for monorepo development. Credentials are passed through environment variables, never command-line arguments. Restart the bridge to apply.

crepair.bridge.configPath.markdownDescription: Custom certfix YAML used instead of the bundled verified config. Model, Provider Order, Allow Fallbacks and Reasoning Effort still override it. Custom configs are unverified. Restart the bridge to apply.

crepair.bridge.port.markdownDescription: TCP port on `127.0.0.1`; `0` automatically chooses a free ephemeral port. Restart the bridge to apply.

crepair.local.preset.markdownDescription: [Set up or start local model](command:crepair.setUpLocal) for initial setup. Use [Local model settings](command:crepair.localSettings) to change the model and its matching GGUF together.
crepair.local.preset.deprecationMessage: Legacy setting. Use Local model settings. After migration, values are stored together in crepair.local.configuration and this individual setting is ignored.

crepair.local.serverPath.markdownDescription: Leave empty for automatic engine preparation. Advanced: absolute path to a compatible llama-server on the extension host.
crepair.local.serverPath.deprecationMessage: Legacy setting. Use Local model settings. After migration, values are stored together in crepair.local.configuration and this individual setting is ignored.

crepair.local.modelPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the selected model GGUF on the extension host.
crepair.local.modelPath.deprecationMessage: Legacy setting. Use Local model settings. After migration, values are stored together in crepair.local.configuration and this individual setting is ignored.

crepair.local.contextTokens.markdownDescription: Total context capacity: input plus thinking and final answer. Increasing this needs more memory and reloads the model on next use.
crepair.local.contextTokens.deprecationMessage: Legacy setting. Use Local model settings. After migration, values are stored together in crepair.local.configuration and this individual setting is ignored.

crepair.local.maxCompletionTokens.markdownDescription: Maximum combined thinking and final-answer tokens for repair, violation detection and semantic validation. Increase after a generation-limit error; context must also fit the input.
crepair.local.maxCompletionTokens.deprecationMessage: Legacy setting. Use Local model settings. After migration, values are stored together in crepair.local.configuration and this individual setting is ignored.

crepair.local.structuredTokens.markdownDescription: Combined reasoning and final-answer limit for declaration completion. Reasoning defaults to off; structuredGeneration can override declaration options.
crepair.local.structuredTokens.deprecationMessage: Legacy setting. Use Local model settings. After migration, values are stored together in crepair.local.configuration and this individual setting is ignored.

crepair.local.effort.markdownDescription: Null uses the preset: Qwen3.8 xhigh, Qwen3.6 model-native thinking. Qwen3.8 supports off/medium/xhigh; Qwen3.6 supports off/model. Custom uses generation/structuredGeneration template kwargs instead.
crepair.local.effort.deprecationMessage: Legacy setting. Use Local model settings. After migration, values are stored together in crepair.local.configuration and this individual setting is ignored.

crepair.local.gpuLayers.markdownDescription: Number of layers on GPU. 99 requests all layers; reduce to move weights to RAM at a speed cost.
crepair.local.gpuLayers.deprecationMessage: Legacy setting. Use Local model settings. After migration, values are stored together in crepair.local.configuration and this individual setting is ignored.

crepair.local.threads.markdownDescription: CPU threads; 0 uses the inference engine default. Mac setup uses 0.
crepair.local.threads.deprecationMessage: Legacy setting. Use Local model settings. After migration, values are stored together in crepair.local.configuration and this individual setting is ignored.

crepair.local.mtpDraftTokens.markdownDescription: Null uses the preset: Qwen3.8 width 2, Qwen3.6/Custom disabled (0). Enable only with compatible model MTP weights/runtime.
crepair.local.mtpDraftTokens.deprecationMessage: Legacy setting. Use Local model settings. After migration, values are stored together in crepair.local.configuration and this individual setting is ignored.

crepair.local.timeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: Timeout for one local inference call. Longer reasoning may take many minutes.
crepair.local.timeoutSeconds.deprecationMessage: Legacy setting. Use Local model settings. After migration, values are stored together in crepair.local.configuration and this individual setting is ignored.

crepair.local.modelName.markdownDescription: Custom model display/request name. Presets use their own names; this does not select or download weights.
crepair.local.modelName.deprecationMessage: Legacy setting. Use Local model settings. After migration, values are stored together in crepair.local.configuration and this individual setting is ignored.

crepair.local.cpuExperts.markdownDescription: Keep MoE expert weights in system RAM (--cpu-moe), trading speed for lower VRAM use. Null uses the preset: on for Qwen3.6, off otherwise. Requires sufficient RAM and a compatible runtime.
crepair.local.cpuExperts.deprecationMessage: Legacy setting. Use Local model settings. After migration, values are stored together in crepair.local.configuration and this individual setting is ignored.

crepair.local.templatePath.markdownDescription: Optional absolute Jinja chat-template file path. Empty uses GGUF metadata. Select a template matching the model.
crepair.local.templatePath.deprecationMessage: Legacy setting. Use Local model settings. After migration, values are stored together in crepair.local.configuration and this individual setting is ignored.

crepair.local.generation.markdownDescription: Custom repair/semantic sampling and chat_template_kwargs. Empty uses runtime/model defaults. Supported keys: temperature, top_p, top_k, min_p, repeat_penalty, presence_penalty, chat_template_kwargs. Does not override routing, prompts or token limits.
crepair.local.generation.deprecationMessage: Legacy setting. Use Local model settings. After migration, values are stored together in crepair.local.configuration and this individual setting is ignored.

crepair.local.structuredGeneration.markdownDescription: Custom declaration-completion sampling and chat_template_kwargs. Configure thinking off here when the model supports it, or allow enough structuredTokens for reasoning plus the final answer.
crepair.local.structuredGeneration.deprecationMessage: Legacy setting. Use Local model settings. After migration, values are stored together in crepair.local.configuration and this individual setting is ignored.

crepair.local.cacheTypeK.markdownDescription: KV cache format. Q8 saves memory; speed depends on hardware. Changes reload the model.
crepair.local.cacheTypeK.deprecationMessage: Legacy setting. Use Local model settings. After migration, values are stored together in crepair.local.configuration and this individual setting is ignored.

crepair.local.cacheTypeV.markdownDescription: KV cache format. Q8 saves memory; speed depends on hardware. Changes reload the model.
crepair.local.cacheTypeV.deprecationMessage: Legacy setting. Use Local model settings. After migration, values are stored together in crepair.local.configuration and this individual setting is ignored.

crepair.local.batchSize.markdownDescription: Input processing batch size. Physical batch (ubatchSize) must not exceed batchSize. Smaller batches can reduce working memory without truncating input.
crepair.local.batchSize.deprecationMessage: Legacy setting. Use Local model settings. After migration, values are stored together in crepair.local.configuration and this individual setting is ignored.

crepair.local.ubatchSize.markdownDescription: Physical batch size; must not exceed the input batch size. Edit it under Local model settings → Advanced settings.
crepair.local.ubatchSize.deprecationMessage: Legacy setting. Use Local model settings. After migration, values are stored together in crepair.local.configuration and this individual setting is ignored.

crepair.local.configuration.markdownDescription: Effective local model configuration, managed by Local model settings. Model changes and related options are saved together.

crepair.local.managedArtifact.markdownDescription: Internal downloaded model identity. Use Local model settings to change models.
crepair.local.managedArtifact.deprecationMessage: Legacy setting. Use Local model settings. After migration, values are stored together in crepair.local.configuration and this individual setting is ignored.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with C Repair
walkthroughs.description: Choose local or API inference, then review your first CERT C repair.

steps.title: Choose local or API inference
steps.description:
Use a downloaded model on your machine, or connect your OpenRouter account.
[Use a local model](command:crepair.setUpLocal)
[Connect OpenRouter](command:crepair.connectOpenRouter)
[Set API Key](command:crepair.setApiKey)
Switching from Local to API? Select Preset, Free or Custom in Settings → Models & Routing → Model Mode as well as connecting your key.
[Settings](command:crepair.openSettings)
[Quick start & user guide](command:crepair.openUserGuide)

steps.title: Choose an API model mode
steps.description:
Choose the preset or free model when prompted. For Custom, use Model Mode in Settings.
[Choose Model Mode](command:crepair.chooseModelMode)
[Settings](command:crepair.openSettings)

steps.title: Prepare the API bridge
steps.description:
Set up the Python bridge once and wait for the ready message.
[Set Up Bridge](command:crepair.setUpBridge)

steps.title: Try the practice file
steps.description:
Open a practice file, then right-click in its C editor and choose Scan & Fix Current File. A Context Review may ask you to confirm declarations first.
[Open practice sample](command:crepair.openPracticeSample)

steps.title: Generate repairs and Accept
steps.description:
Review each fix as a diff, read the validation gates, then accept.
[Scan & Fix Current File](command:crepair.scanAndFixCurrentFile)
